name: Muñoveros (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, white above and purple below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Muñoveros (the leader Juan Bravo with a crimson banner on yellow, and the aqueduct on red).
history: Muñoveros adopted its arms and flag officially on 20 March 1997, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 18 April 1997; the flag is rectangular, of proportion 2:3, parted per bend by a diagonal line from the upper dexter to the lower sinister corner into two parts.
